input.description: A `[..., samples]` `float32`/`float64` `Tensor` containing the signals to take the DCT of. type: The IDCT type to perform. Must be 1, 2, 3 or 4.

n.description: For future expansion. The length of the transform. Must be `None`.

axis.description: For future expansion. The axis to compute the DCT along. Must be `-1`.

norm.description: The normalization to apply. `None` for no normalization or `'ortho'` for orthonormal normalization.

name.description: An optional name for the operation.

output.description: A `[..., samples]` `float32`/`float64` `Tensor` containing the IDCT of `input`.
